summary: Three churches (St. Louis, Blessed Sacrament, St. Michael's) in the Downtown Family; the front-page Mass box, confession list and Adoration hours are identical in all five bulletins. St. Joseph's Cathedral and the Oratory of St. Anthony share the box but are other parishes' churches (left out). St. Michael's morning Confession is worked out at 7:15-8:30 AM after the 6:45 Mass. One grouped question: whether the blanket 'confession on request after any Mass' line should become Confession slots after each Mass (leaning include, per C5).
